newsitem.title: USA: Tandem names former DEC executive as new Pres.
newsitem.headline: Tandem names former DEC executive as new Pres.

text.p: Tandem Computer Inc. on Monday named Enrico Pesatori, a former vice president and general manager at Digital Equipment Corp. as Tandem's new president and chief operating officer.

Pesatori, 55, assumes the president's position from Chief Executive Officer Roel Pieper, who took the helm of Tandem in January of this year amid a company restructuring. Pieper remains chief executive and assumes the role of vice chairman.
Pieper will focus on corporate strategy and financing, and Pesatori will concentrate on day-to-day production and sales at the maker of large scale computing systems.
"This is all about strengthening the management team to execute our strategy that has Himalaya (high-end computers) at its foundation and Windows NT as an addition," Pieper said in a teleconference.

Tandem's Himalaya computers are top-of-the-line systems used in large corporations, whereas smaller scale computing networks increasingly are being designed around Microsoft Corp.'s Windows NT operating system.
Since joining Tandem in January this year, Pieper has been refocusing it toward open computing systems using Windows NT.
In 1993, Pesatori started Digital's Intel Corp.-based personal computer business, and he was able to grow it to a $2.5 billion division in three years.

In 1994, he became general manager of Digital's core computer systems division, which at the time represented about two-thirds of Digital's revenues, and helped refocus it toward more open systems based computing products.
"(One) thing I bring from Digital is adapting the business model of the company to different markets," Pesatori said.
As chief operating officer, Pesatori replaces Robert Marshall, who retired in December 1995. Thomas Perkins remains chairman of Tandem's board of directors.
Tandem's shares closed up 37.5 cents at $12.875 on Monday in New York Stock Exchange trading. The announcement came after the stock market's close.
